Primary request: a kinetic routing machine turns scattered business events into governed, resilient automated pathways across a coherent system

Subject: one compact navy routing machine with physical cyan rails, smooth structural hubs, gates, and recovery loops carrying simple blank geometric tokens; a single orange override lever on a completely plain housing signals governance
Style/medium: premium tactile editorial illustration with hand-built mechanical model detail, not a software interface
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; three-quarter isometric view; one unified machine silhouette; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: reliable, orchestrated, quietly technical, restrained backlighting
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Materials/textures: matte enamel, painted wood, frosted acrylic, subtle paper grain, controlled shadows
Constraints: all hubs and housings are smooth and completely blank; absolutely no dial faces, tick marks, glyphs, embossed marks, punched templates, or control panels; no software UI; original composition; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, product UI, vendor logos, trademarks, watermarks, paws, paw imagery, paw logos, cats, cat silhouettes, or Microsoft Fluent styling
Avoid: Microsoft branding, familiar app icons, flowchart symbols, dashboards, screens, marked controls, cables forming letters, generic robots, clutter
